messages:
Samir: drafting internal release note for tomorrow's canary — quick review please. target deploy 10:00am PT, 3 replicas, pin to model v2.1.4 for the rollout.

Samir: draft blurb below, feel free to edit inline: 
```
Release 2026-03-21 (canary)
- Deploys model v2.1.4 (latency optimizations, token cache fix)
- Canary to 10% traffic for 2 hours, metrics gating on p50 latency and error-rate
- Known issue: slight increase in memory on xlarge for long context (>4096 tokens) — mitigated by autoscale policy
```

Elaine: LGTM overall. can we call out rollback trigger: p50 > 220ms OR 5xx > 0.6% over 5m? adds clarity for ops. :+1:

Samir: good call. adding that. also thinking we should pin the console announcement to top channel and notify SRE.

Maya: can we also include the quick command for pinning and rollback? makes it easy for oncall.

Samir: yes. adding snippet: 
```
# pin release note in #eng-releases
/post "Release 2026-03-21 canary: v2.1.4 -> 10% for 2h. Rollback if p50 > 220ms or 5xx > 0.6% over 5m."
```

Jorge: deploy-bot will post the canary event once the job is scheduled. who is owning watch? @Elaine or @Leo?

Elaine: I can watch the first hour. Leo can take the 2nd hour. I'll be on standby for rollback ops.

Leo: confirmed. I'll have rollback playbook open. Quick question: are we auto-failing over to v2.0.9 or to model-stable alias?

Samir: plan is to fallback to model-stable alias which currently points at v2.0.9. ensures we always have the tested stable.

deploy-bot: Scheduled canary job #cj-20260321-14: start=2026-03-21T17:00:00Z, replicas=3, traffic=10%. Notifying channel #eng-releases.

Maya: small nit on the RN text — change "token cache fix" -> "KV cache correctness fix" for precision.

Samir: updated draft with that wording. final version below: 
```
Release 2026-03-21 (canary)
- Deploy model v2.1.4 (latency optimizations, KV cache correctness fix)
- Canary: 10% traffic for 2 hours, gating on p50 latency and 5xx rate
- Rollback triggers: p50 latency > 220ms OR 5xx rate > 0.6% (5m window) -> fallback to model-stable (v2.0.9)
- Note: observed memory growth on xlarge with >4096 tokens; autoscale mitigates but monitor tail latency
```

Jorge: perfect. I'll pin the RN once deploy-bot posts and tag SRE+Support.

Elaine: thanks all. I'll post a short checklist in the thread 10m before start: metrics dashboard link + rollback commands.

Samir: thanks everyone. leaving this thread for pin + ops watch. :rocket:
